# Replix AI

> Replix AI turns Shopify products into scroll-stopping Instagram and Facebook ad creatives in seconds — copy, hook, and visuals generated by AI.

Replix AI is a web app for Shopify merchants. Connect a store, pick a product, choose a style, and the AI returns ready-to-post ads (hook + caption + on-brand image) cropped to every major IG/FB spec. Free tier includes 3 ads/month; paid tiers scale from 50 to 250 ads/month.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, how it works, features, and pricing.
- [Help & FAQ](/help): Answers about generating ads, connecting Shopify, credits, billing, and exporting.
- [Sign in](/login): Account login and signup.
